title: DVB-T2 BICM AWGN campaign runner (binary + plot + reference data)
description:
## Goal

A reusable CLI binary that runs the full DVB-T2 BICM AWGN simulation
for one (rate, modulation) configuration, producing a CSV curve, a
PNG overlay vs the ETSI TR 102 831 reference, and a JSON tracing log.
Six invocations (3 rates × 2 modulations) reproduce every curve
required by the epic.

## Context

This task is the consumer of:

- NEW-INFRA: resumable, observable `SimulationRunner`,
- NEW-1: DVB-T2 BCH+LDPC concatenated codec,
- 87a2402f: column-row bit interleaver,
- existing Gray-QAM mapper / demapper in
  `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/`,
- a generalisation of the existing `BpskAwgnChannel` to a
  `QamAwgnChannel` for 16-QAM and 64-QAM.

The TP07a vector validation (4cdaf1c5) is a hard prereq so we know
the BICM chain matches the standard bit-exactly before throwing CPU
hours at FER curves.

## Deliverables

1. New binary: `crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`
   (or a similarly named binary; placement in `src/bin/` matches the
   existing `sim_runner.rs`).
2. CLI accepts at minimum:
   - `--rate {1/2|2/3|3/4}`
   - `--modulation {16qam|64qam}`
   - `--esn0-range <start>:<stop>:<step>` (dB)
   - `--target-errors <N>` (default 100)
   - `--max-frames <N>`
   - `--seed <u64>`
   - `--output-dir <path>`
   - `--resume`
3. Output layout under `<output-dir>/`:
   - `curve_<rate>_<mod>.csv` — columns: es_n0_db, fer, ber, frames,
     errors, mean_iters, wall_seconds (one row per SNR point).
   - `curve_<rate>_<mod>.png` — simulated vs ETSI TR 102 831
     reference overlay using `plotters` (or another headless,
     CI-friendly plotting backend; the choice is recorded in
     CLAUDE.md and the new binary's rustdoc).
   - `tracing.jsonl` — structured `tracing` log via NEW-INFRA.
   - `README.md` — invocation, RNG seed, host info, total wall-clock.
4. ETSI TR 102 831 reference points checked in as a small,
   hand-extracted TOML file under
   `crates/gf2-coding/data/dvb_t2_tr102831_reference.toml`. One entry
   per MODCOD listing (es_n0_db, fer) points read from the report's
   figures. The file header cites the table / figure numbers.
5. `--resume` propagates through to NEW-INFRA's checkpoint behaviour
   so the binary inherits crash recovery for free.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Binary builds without warnings under
  `cargo build --workspace --all-features --release`.
- [hard] A smoke campaign (3 SNR points, small frame budget) completes
  end-to-end and produces all four output artefacts.
- [hard] The PNG overlay shows simulated and reference curves on the
  same axes with a legend identifying each; rendering is
  non-interactive / headless (CI-safe; no display required).
- [hard] Killing the binary with SIGINT mid-run and re-invoking with
  `--resume` results in a final CSV that is byte-identical to an
  uninterrupted reference run with the same seed (integration test).
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated to list the new binary and the reference
  data file.
- [hard] No new `unsafe`; satisfies `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.

## Non-goals

- No interactive UI.
- No code refactoring beyond what is needed to plug 16-QAM / 64-QAM
  into the existing mapper / demapper.
- No new channel model (AWGN only).
- This task does NOT execute the production campaigns — that is
  e4849f07. Smoke runs only here.
